title: Altar of the Sunne & Ultra Space by Ritsen
description: This datapack adds the Altar of the Sunne, Ultra Space and ways to obtain all Ultra Beasts, Necrozma and the Cosmog line to Cobblemon.
body:
This datapack adds the Altar of the Sunne, Ultra Space and ways to obtain all Ultra Beasts, Necrozma and the Cosmog line to Cobblemon.

You are free to add this datapack to any modpack!

# Guide
Find the Altar of the Sunne in the badlands, wooded badlands or eroded badlands. Here you will be able to summon Solgaleo and find an inactive Ultra Wormhole. Figure out how to activate it and cross it. It will take you to the decision limbo. Here you will find 3 types of broken Ultra Wormholes. Figure out how to restore them.

One of the broken Ultra Wormholes will take you to a "parallel overworld" that has 1 important structure (Lake of the Sunne). There, you can summon Cosmog.

Another one will take you to Ultra Megalopolis. In there, 1 Ultra Beast can Spawn. Aside from that and the common buildings, you will be able to find Necrozma's tower. That's where you summon it. Be prepared for its level, it's supposed to be this datapack's final boss. ULTRA MEGALOPOLIS IS A DANGEROUS PLACE. People live there, and they see you as a menace.

The last Ultra Wormhole inside the decision limbo will take you to Ultra Space. There, you will find 9 types of broken Ultra Wormholes. Each one will take you to the Ultra Beasts' home dimensions. 2 Of them are made up. These ones being Stakataka and Blacephalon's home dimensions, of course. Oh, and there are shulkers in Ultra Space.

# Notes
-This being a datapack, it does not add models for the Pokémon.

-This whole datapack is more of a suggestion for how Ultra Beasts should be added into Cobblemon rather than a serious project.
